steps.eval: fetch('/api/radar').then(r => r.json()).then(list => { const rounds = list.map(c => c.lastRoundLabel); for (const r of ['Pre-seed', 'Seed', 'Series B', 'Series C']) if (!rounds.includes(r)) throw new Error('radar missing ' + r); if (!list.some(c => c.assetClass === 'secondary')) throw new Error('no late-stage secondaries'); if (/broker/i.test(document.getElementById('radar').innerText)) throw new Error('broker on the Radar'); })
(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; if (/Potential outcomes|3 to 4x|Aspen|Bentley|Emerson|Principal acquirer/i.test(t)) throw new Error('projection or real comparable on the deal page'); })()
fetch('/deals/aurelia').then(r => r.text()).then(html => { if (/Principal acquirer|AltSpot acquired/.test(html)) throw new Error('principal copy on a secondary'); })
